Student Academic Advising Information System (SAAIS) API (0.2.0)

Download OpenAPI specification:

License: Proprietary

Target SAAIS API contract: read-only PostgREST projections and authenticated transactional Edge Function writes. The confirmed SRS governs business rules. This specification and its x-required-roles metadata do not implement authorization, pagination, rate limiting or database guards: those must be enforced by the gateway, RLS and verified server operations before deployment. Supabase Auth handles hosted sessions and password/Google flows; this contract describes application provisioning and academic operations. Scheduled INC cache maintenance is service-only internal database work, not a SPA operation.

Profile

User profiles and institutional role accounts

Query user profiles

List or filter user profiles via PostgREST query parameters. Students can only select their own profile via RLS. Advisers can select assigned advisees. Admins have system-wide visibility. Flat columns are allowlisted per x-projection-fields; role metadata documents checks, not automatic runtime authorization. Inaccessible/missing collection rows return 200 [], while invalid role/column requests may return 403.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
query Parameters
id
string <= 1900 characters ^(?:(?:eq|neq)\.[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}...

Allowlisted PostgREST UUID filter: eq.UUID, neq.UUID or in.(UUID,...), at most 50 IDs. URL-encode the complete value; format:uuid would be wrong for the operator-prefixed string.

email
string <= 257 characters ^eq\.[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$

Filter by email equality (e.g. eq.student@university.edu.ph)

role
string <= 250 characters ^eq\.(student|adviser|admin)$

Filter by role (e.g. eq.student)

status
string <= 40 characters ^eq\.(invited|active|disabled)$

Filter this entity’s valid status.

student_number
string <= 70 characters ^eq\.[^\x00-\x1f]{1,64}$

Filter by student number (e.g. eq.2023-04412)

select
string <= 2000 characters ^(?:id|role|email|full_name|student_number|st...
Default: "id,role,email,full_name,student_number,status,created_at,updated_at,faculty_id"

Only these flat safe columns. On private-column tables the client must explicitly send this projection; PostgREST does not apply OpenAPI defaults.

order
string <= 1000 characters ^(?:id|role|email|full_name|student_number|st...
Default: "id.asc"

Stable ordering on published columns only; whitelist and enforce at runtime.

limit
integer [ 1 .. 1000 ]
Default: 20
Example: limit=20

Bounded page size; gateway/PostgREST max-rows must enforce this cap even when clients omit or bypass contract validation.

offset
integer [ 0 .. 100000 ]
Default: 0
Example: offset=0

Number of rows to skip for DoS pagination mitigation

faculty_id
string <= 1900 characters ^(?:(?:eq|neq)\.[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}...

Allowlisted PostgREST UUID filter: eq.UUID, neq.UUID or in.(UUID,...), at most 50 IDs. URL-encode the complete value; format:uuid would be wrong for the operator-prefixed string.

Terms & Offerings

Calendar school terms, term locks, and course offerings

Query calendar school terms

Retrieve academic school terms with lock states and override flags. Flat columns are allowlisted per x-projection-fields; role metadata documents checks, not automatic runtime authorization. Inaccessible/missing collection rows return 200 [], while invalid role/column requests may return 403.

Authorizations:
bearerAuth
query Parameters
id
string <= 1900 characters ^(?:(?:eq|neq)\.[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}...

Allowlisted PostgREST UUID filter: eq.UUID, neq.UUID or in.(UUID,...), at most 50 IDs. URL-encode the complete value; format:uuid would be wrong for the operator-prefixed string.

school_year
string <= 16 characters ^eq\.[0-9]{4} - [0-9]{4}$

Filter by school year (e.g. eq.2025 - 2026)

is_locked
string <= 250 characters ^eq\.(true|false)$

Filter by lock state (e.g. eq.true)

select
string <= 2000 characters ^(?:id|start_year|end_year|term_type|school_y...
Default: "id,start_year,end_year,term_type,school_year,is_locked,override_flag,override_actor_id,override_at,ends_on,default_inc_deadline,chronological_key"

Only these flat safe columns. On private-column tables the client must explicitly send this projection; PostgREST does not apply OpenAPI defaults.

order
string <= 1000 characters ^(?:id|start_year|end_year|term_type|school_y...
Default: "id.asc"

Stable ordering on published columns only; whitelist and enforce at runtime.

limit
integer [ 1 .. 1000 ]
Default: 20
Example: limit=20

Bounded page size; gateway/PostgREST max-rows must enforce this cap even when clients omit or bypass contract validation.

offset
integer [ 0 .. 100000 ]
Default: 0
Example: offset=0

Number of rows to skip for DoS pagination mitigation
